chunks: But those who disbelieve and deny Our revelations are residents of Hell.
ai.seo_question: Who are the residents of Hell according to this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Ma'idah underscores the consequence of rejecting not just the message, but the divine signs (Ayat) themselves, linking intellectual denial to spiritual ruin. It serves as a foundational text for the concept of 'Jahim' as a specific, lower tier of Hell reserved for those who actively mocked or dismissed clear proofs. This reinforces the Shia emphasis on the necessity of recognizing both the truth of the message and the authority of the Prophet and Imams as carriers of divine signs.
